# Project Disclaimer

**Synthetic data.** Every record in this project was generated by `python/generate_project_data.py` to imitate the structure of an omnichannel fashion retailer. No real transactions, customers, prices, costs or inventory are used.

**No confidential information.** The project contains no proprietary data, metrics, schemas, systems or internal documents of Nordstrom, Inc. or any other company.

**Names.** The retail channel names (Nordstrom Stores, Nordstrom.com, Rack Stores, NordstromRack.com) and event names describe a realistic scenario for a portfolio exercise. All trademarks belong to their owners.

**No affiliation or endorsement.** The project was built independently by Daniel Rodriguez III for professional demonstration. It is not affiliated with, sponsored by or endorsed by Nordstrom, Inc.

**Results are not evidence about any real company.** Effects such as price response, event traffic lift and cannibalization were built into the simulation so that the analysis could be checked against known truth. Findings show that the method works and what decisions it could support; they do not describe how any real retailer performs.

**Illustrative documents.** The decision memo's recipient and recommendations are illustrative.
